hard_limits.missing_positive_fixture: If no qualifying pre-existing Source exists, read-only saved recognition cannot be proved. Record the empty lookup honestly; do not loop on or retry the reserved Save.
hard_limits.late_save: An old reserved checkpoint is not a live inflight request. No read-only operation can recreate an actual late Save completion. Native late-Save proof requires a separately authorized new mutation scenario with its own fresh fixture/attempt identity; this assessment authorizes none. Keep this dimension unverified while using existing forcing tests only for their engineering scope.
hard_limits.closure: Do not close D22 solely after bounded read-only scope passes. Its recorded closure requires authenticated multi-workspace UI verification. Parent must reconcile the completed engineering evidence with the precise remaining native predicates; broader inventory coverage and native late Save must not be silently relabeled passed.

recommendation: Finish read-only recognition proof on the current build; preserve all existing repairs and the immutable attempt. Treat absence of native proof as an evidence gap, not grounds for another speculative production rewrite.

alias_repair.cause: Saved captures list selects url:canonical_identity, but initial discovery read canonical_identity and rejected every real list row.
alias_repair.change: Discovery reads row.url and fixture.url. Point lookup still requires row.canonical_identity matching exact selected page identity. Public-host/query/fragment constraints remain unchanged.
alias_repair.validation: Targeted Biome and node --check only; independent repair review and native execution remain pending. No claim that this source repair proves live fixture availability.

discovery_repair.cause: Three arbitrary reference hosts excluded all returned first-page candidates; original output cannot distinguish empty list from disallowed-host rows.
discovery_repair.diagnostics: Counts pages, total returned rows, examined unique rows, URL-present rows, HTTP(S) rows, examined public-eligible rows and rejection categories. Each actual list response records only HTTP status, row count, alias selected, cursor presence, numeric limit; each UI pagination step records only readiness and Load more count/enabled state. No URLs/IDs/hostnames/bodies.
discovery_repair.pagination: Only an observed backend page shorter than its captured limit earns exhausted=true. A full backend page without a usable Load more button reports source_full_page_pagination_unavailable. Later pages require the same origin/limit/order and exact expected keyset cursor derived from the uniquely matching last visible card. A refresh or unexpected cursor yields unverified; duplicate visible presentations cannot invent a cursor.
discovery_repair.network_safety: Before the fresh owned fixture page visits a Source URL, CDP disables its script execution and bypasses site service workers. Its page-route boundary rejects intercepted non-GET/HEAD requests and unsafe public-URL categories. Real sign-in/token exchange and extension recognition remain in separate realms and may legitimately use POST; this is not a claim of zero POSTs across the authenticated browser. The runner never invokes Source mutation/capture/filing controls. DNS preflight is not a rebinding guarantee, and URL classification cannot prove every GET endpoint is side-effect-free.
discovery_repair.runtime: Not run; source review required before root admission. No claim that existing qualifying rows will be available.
discovery_repair.deadline: One discovery deadline controls admission and acceptance. Read-only list/UI observations and DNS classification race remaining time. Started UI input (including whole workspace selections, section opening and pagination clicks) is awaited to settlement before checking expiry and entering cleanup. Therefore wall-clock time may exceed discovery budget by the one in-flight driver operation plus restoration; existing driver operation timeouts apply. A stalled transport may require root guard termination and earns no cleanup claim. OS DNS lookup is not cancellable but cannot dispatch UI input or produce acceptance after its deadline.

peer_repair.status: Source repairs implemented; independent re-review and native run pending.
peer_repair.protocol_evidence: Installed playwright-core/types/protocol.d.ts documents Network.setBypassServiceWorker as bypassing service worker for each request, and Emulation.setScriptExecutionDisabled as disabling script execution. Applied only to the owned fixture page before navigation; native extension service worker remains active.
peer_repair.runtime: No browser or tests run in repair lane. Fixed categories/counts only in report; cursor IDs/dates/URLs and card labels remain in memory.

multi_workspace_discovery.status: Implemented; independent source review and native execution pending.
multi_workspace_discovery.authorization: Existing accessible organizations selected explicitly through real UI are within the multi-workspace test scope. The private approved organization remains original baseline and mandatory cleanup target; no production fallback or organization-selection policy is changed.
multi_workspace_discovery.flow: Search original workspace first. Only after its scoped list exhausts without a fixture, enumerate unique names from actual organization-picker options. Explicitly select each bounded candidate, read its stored selected ID, require scoped actual list response for that ID, and run existing page/cursor/URL guards. Genuine Source in candidate workspace becomes positive; original workspace becomes comparison. Every comparison still requires its own actual scoped point lookup, never assumes negative from earlier list alone.
multi_workspace_discovery.bounds: SOURCE_DISCOVERY_MAX_ORGS defaults to3 including original. SOURCE_DISCOVERY_TOTAL_MS defaults to180000 for admission/result acceptance across discovery; each workspace also keeps existing page and60000ms bounds. Started UI operations settle before deadline failure/cleanup and can exceed the nominal deadline; actual overrun is recorded in discoveryUiSettlementOverrunMs. Cleanup time is separate. Missing fixture reports only examined-workspace results.
multi_workspace_discovery.diagnostics: Only examined ordinal, original/not-original, UI-selection/query-match booleans, choice/attempt counts and existing safe per-workspace list/eligibility counts. Names, IDs, URLs and row bodies remain private in memory.
multi_workspace_discovery.cleanup: Outer finally always selects and verifies original approved workspace ID, including failed candidate selection or absent fixtures. Positive restoration is separately labeled positiveRecognitionRestored. No Source/checkpoint/capture/Save writes.

cleanup_repair.change: Every discovery operation capable of UI input uses discoveryUiStep, which checks admission, awaits completion/rejection without Promise.race, then checks deadline. Only read-only observations/DNS retain the timer race. Final original-workspace restore cannot overlap a still-running discovery selection or click.
cleanup_repair.failure_truth: Expired deadline yields unverified only after started UI work settles. A nonsettling driver/transport does not reach workspaceCleanup=pass; root guard may terminate owned disposable profile. No fictitious cancellation or hard total wall-clock bound is claimed.
cleanup_repair.validation: Targeted Biome and node syntax check; no runtime/test execution. Narrow independent re-review pending.

positive_diagnostics_repair.safe_evidence: Boolean start/return markers, response HTTP status, exact-fixture URL equality only, elapsed positive-sequence milliseconds, navigation failure counts from fixed allowlist, scoped observed/completed/HTTP200/failed/returned-row counts, Scrape DOM booleans and tab count/active state. No raw URLs, IDs, error messages, headers or response bodies.
positive_diagnostics_repair.error_classification: Fixed known Chromium net-error categories, known pointer driver codes, timeout/wait category and unclassified_exception fallback. Never echo raw exception. Evidence is captured before workspace cleanup can alter UI.
positive_diagnostics_repair.choice_counts: choicesEnumeratedFromPicker=false until actual option enumeration; initialized baseline count alone is never full account/workspace census. Multi-workspace and late lookup remain unverified until their actual predicates pass.
positive_diagnostics_repair.preserved_behavior: No acceptance predicate weakened; no fixture creation, writes, retries, checkpoint access or new runtime launch. Diagnostic repair only.
